description: Run a batch of browser steps in one call; stops at the first failure with a forensic report (reason, near-miss candidates, console/network errors, pre-failure page changes). Success returns only what changed, not the full page. A batch may start cold with {"goto":url}, which opens the browser too, so a flow whose targets you can already name needs no reflex_open.

quiet.description: self-guarded batch returns only the result, not a page snapshot

steps.description: Each step is one object: {"goto":url} {"click":t} {"dblclick":t} {"hover":t} {"focus":t} {"fill":[t,value]} {"type":[t,text]} {"press":key} {"select":[t,option]} {"upload":[t,path]} {"check":t} {"uncheck":t} {"scroll":{"by":px}} {"scroll":{"to":t}} {"wait":ms} {"wait":{"text":s}} {"wait":{"url_contains":s}} {"expect":{"visible":t | "hidden":t | "text":s | "url_contains":s | "value":v,"target":t | "download":"*.pdf"}} {"shot":label} {"eval":js}. Target t: ref (a3f2), accessible name, or css=/xpath=. Secrets: {{env:VAR}}. Use expect guards between actions. Downloads auto-save (path in response). Compounds: {"if":{"visible":t,"then":[],"else":[]}} {"try":[steps]} {"repeat":{"do":[],"until":cond,"max":N}} {"extract":t} {"fetch":url}.

name: reflex_act
